meta.parties: Hawke Et Al. v. Sabapathy Et Al

rules.statement: Where the property is subject to a fidei commissum and any partition decreed will not be of a permanent character, it is not desirable or expedient to order a partition.
rules.supporting_quote: "I feel that the reasons against the entering of a decree for partition in the present action are even more cogent than in Fernando v. Fernando 1, 1 (1915) 1 C. W. R. 46."
